name: Jerry Springer
bio: Gerald Norman Springer (February 13, 1944 - April 27, 2023) was an English-American television presenter, politician, news presenter, actor, producer, musician, and former lawyer. He hosted The Jerry Springer Show, a tabloid talk show, between September 30, 1991 and July 26, 2018 and debuted the Jerry Springer Podcast in 2015.
